import os

base_dir = "~/documents/work/meetings_files/"
file_names = set()

for file_path in files:
    filename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    # Format: <date>__<file_name>.<extension>
    # Split on "__"
    parts = filename.split("__", 1)
    date = parts[0]
    rest = parts[1]  # <file_name>.<extension>
    file_name = os.path.splitext(rest)[0]
    file_names.add(file_name)

print("Unique file names:", file_names)

# Create directories for each file_name
for file_name in file_names:
    dir_path = base_dir + file_name
    result = apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=dir_path, recursive=True)
    print(f"Created {dir_path}: {result}")
